descToken: Use the Setup Token to load configurable keys for this environment. The token stays in this browser session only — it is never stored or echoed.
descTokenRepair: Install status is failed. begin(reason=repair) freezes the blocking-key allowlist; only those keys can be changed later.
descPlatform: Namespace platform. Leave blank to seed declared defaults. Keys marked blocking must pass connectivity checks.
descBusiness: Covers identity / iam / tenant / notification / audit. Repair mode only shows blocking keys.
descSecrets: Sensitive keys are not stored in Item snapshots. Auto-generated secrets are written by the server; others can be entered here (never echoed back).
descReview: Runs begin (lease) → apply (seed snapshot & secrets) → complete (ready when gaps are empty).
guideToken1: Ensure CONFIG_INSTALL_SETUP_TOKEN is injected on the deploy side and matches this value.
guideToken2: Load the schema, then continue to platform config. A failed state enters repair automatically.
guideToken3: Deploy env vars such as ADMIN_FRAME_DB_DSN are not collected here — fix them in infra and restart config-api.
guideToken4: Owner is optional; after begin it becomes the lease holder for audit.
guideRepair1: Fix deploy_env_missing gaps first (the wizard cannot write them).
guideRepair2: Optionally declare extra blocking keys the server could not infer.
guideRepair3: After loading, later steps only render blocking keys.
guidePlatform1: Resolve blocking fields first or complete will be rejected.
guidePlatform2: Hot-reloadable keys take effect without a rolling restart.
guidePlatform3: Connectivity failures remain in remaining_gaps — return here to fix.
guidePlatform4: Non-blocking keys with defaults can be skipped and published later.
guideBusiness1: Clear blocking items first, then override defaults as needed.
guideBusiness2: New keys with defaults are reconciled after ready — no need to force-fill.
guideBusiness3: After install, non-blocking changes go through edit → submit → approve → publish.
guideSecrets1: Auto-generated secrets are written during install; this page only shows rules.
guideSecrets2: Writable secrets (Redis password, SMTP password, …) are stored encrypted.
guideSecrets3: Rotate or grant access later under System → Config Center → Secrets.
guideReview1: Review explicit overrides; other keys use declared defaults.
guideReview2: If apply returns remaining_gaps, stay here and fix them.
guideReview3: After complete, begin is rejected until a new repair cycle.
alertDeployDesc: Detected deploy_env_missing (often ADMIN_FRAME_DB_DSN). It is not part of the wizard — fix it on the deploy side and restart config-api.
alertSecretsTitle: Plaintext never enters the config snapshot
alertSecretsDesc: Gaps show as secret_missing. Resolution requires a service grant. Auto-generated values are not shown here.
alertReadyDesc: The primary action runs the full install pipeline. After success, sign in to verify the admin console.
alertRepairEmptyPlatform: No blocking keys in this domain for repair — nothing to change.
alertRepairEmptyBusiness: Repair only allows blocking keys; use submit → approve → publish for other changes.
tokenHelp: Required for schema and write APIs. Proxied via admin-api to config-api — the browser never talks to config-api directly.
ownerHelp: Recorded as the install lease holder for audit.
declaredHelp: One namespace/key per line or comma-separated. Must be declared, non-sensitive, and missing from the active snapshot.
secretsEmpty: No sensitive keys declared for this environment.
msgNeedToken: Enter the Setup Token before loading the schema.
msgReady: Install is complete. You can return to login.
msgSchemaRepair: Repair mode: only blocking keys are editable ({count})
msgRemaining: {count} blocking key(s) remain — fill them and submit again (no need to begin again).
